hooks.text: 在血泊表面高速滑行可穿越敌群，并把暴力产生的能量转化为高伤攻击。
hooks.excerpt: Bloodsurf the sanguinary surface of gore left in the wake of your destruction to slip past foes and cleave through hordes of the grotesque. Harvest energy from violence and unleash devastating attacks upon those foolish enough to stand in your way!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 死亡会把角色送回牢房中枢，但每次复活获得的 Malice 可永久提升并分化能力。
hooks.excerpt: Your prison cell is your hub world which you’ll be teleported to every time you die, but you won’t return empty-handed. Malice gained upon each revival can be used in many different ways to permanently increase and diversify your strengths.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 剧情以一战后的咆哮二十年代为背景，把真实犯罪与历史人物转化为 NPC 和 Boss 线索。
hooks.excerpt: Relive the Roaring 1920s as Penny Blood: Hellbound takes you through the fallout of World War I and the shadowy side of the societal changes that ensued. Featuring NPCs and bosses connected to true crime and real-world history, the Hellhounders’ story gives an intimate look at some of the issues and events of the era.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
